authorityRule: The HD_WindowHandle_ component entry in material_construction_lookdev.json records provenance for the generated fallback rectangles only. During formal evidence those 60 EPDM renderers must remain disabled. Active visible window-lock construction and material metadata is authoritative only when facade_sash_latch_contract.json, the anodized_aluminum material record and the galvanized_steel fastener record agree with the physical FacadeSashLatchHardware scene QA.
geometryVsMaterialRule: Lock base plate, pivot boss, swept crescent lever, keeper throat, screw heads, seating offsets and all four LOD silhouettes are geometry. Aluminum/galvanized microstructure, oxidation, recess grime, hand-contact polish, wet response, UV aging and angular/Fresnel response remain material/weathering behavior. Neither the disabled EPDM fallback nor painted highlights may substitute for manufactured latch geometry.
lookdevBrief: Use the actual formal latch assembly in frontal, 35-degree oblique and midsummer grazing-light evidence. The 100-percent sash-latch crop must resolve one metal crescent lock per two-panel window, 50 mm mounting-screw pitch, lever-to-keeper clearance, seated plate/receiver interfaces, distinct aluminum-versus-fastener response and zero visible legacy rubber rectangles. Grazing highlights must roll from geometry plus BRDF/Fresnel rather than albedo paint. Temporal oblique evidence must show four-level cross-fade without visible pop or shimmer.
